events.name: 2026 U.S. House party winner
events.longDescription:
Who will be the Party to win the U.S. House in 2026?

Contracts resolve based on which party controls the U.S. House in the 2026 Congress election, as determined by the party affiliation of the Speaker of the House on the Expiration Date. Control is established when the Speaker of the House is a member of a given party, including any Independent who formally caucuses with that party's congressional caucus. Resolution occurs once the first determination is recorded by the Source Agency; any subsequent revision will not affect settlement once determined. If the Speaker of the House position is vacant on the Expiration Date, resolution is based on the party affiliation of the Speaker Pro Tempore; if neither has been designated, the Expiration Date is delayed until one is serving. If the Source Agency has not announced a result by the Expiration Date, contracts will remain open until the result is released. In the event a result cannot be determined, the contract will be settled to fair market value as determined by Rothera.

Get $1 for every contract you own if your prediction is correct. Or close your position before the event resolves. Additional fees apply. Read the full [contract terms and conditions](https://publicfiles.rotheramarkets.com/contract_terms/CongressionalControl-T&C.pdf)

events.name: Florida Governor winner
events.longDescription:
Who will be the Party and/or Party to win the Florida Governor?

Contracts resolve based on the political party affiliation of the winning candidate in the 2026 Florida Governor race as determined by officially reported results. Resolution occurs once the Source Agency has reported a result; any subsequent revision will not affect settlement once determined.
